Dua for Halal Job 3295 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 49642 Country: India Title: How to overcome out of bad times. Question: Last year I resigned from my job and started civil services preparation but just after starting preparation I am continuously suffering from one or another health problems and I also face so many failures from that time from everywhere that I am just going to get broken down completely. I do not know what Allah (swt) wants and I still have full faith on him but recently I faced a spine disc displacement problem due to which as per doctor advice I am restricted to bend my back forward and weight lifting. And there is also a severe in ruku and sajda position. Please suggest me the dua so that I will overcome out from this bad time. Answer ID: 49642 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 143/144/N=02/1435) You should recite istighfar excessively and recite Ya Salam (یا سلام) 142 times daily after Fajr and Maghrib salah. All your problems will vanish in-shaAllah. We also pray: may Allah remove all your problems and anxieties, Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
